status: Design budgets; not full PVT/local-mismatch qualification
basis: Rounded design budgets informed by the historical V2.0.3 SS/SF envelope and V2.1.0 waveform screening. The initial 1200 ps budget missed the SS 16x16 sequence read deadline, so the smallest budget is 1600 ps. Historical fits are not executed at runtime. See docs/design/TIMING_LOOKUP_V2_1_0.md for exact coverage and limits. The initial 512-row budget missed SS distributed read (3.341 ns clock-to-data), so the 512-row budget is 3600 ps.
policy: T = ceil_to_50ps(2 * max(row.half_period_ps, column.half_period_ps) * (1 + margin)); default margin 0.25. Round dimensions up to anchors, extrapolate the final geometric ladder beyond them and flag the result. Classes are shared by cell type, mux and physical wiring; custom RC still requires waveform checks.
